import openpyxl
from datetime import datetime

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('init.xlsx')
ws = wb['Sheet1']

now = datetime.now()
# Delete columns I (9) through AQ (43) since all dates are earlier than current month/year
for col in range(43, 8, -1):
    ws.delete_cols(col)

wb.save('output.xlsx')
print('done')
